headline: Why Xylem (XYL) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of water technology company Xylem (NYSE:XYL) jumped 4.4% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter results that beat profit estimates and included a raised full-year earnings forecast, despite a miss on other key metrics. The company posted an adjusted profit of $1.46 per share, which was 9.2% above the analyst consensus of $1.34. However, the quarter presented a mixed picture for investors.
